name: The London, New York City
positioning: The London, a Luxury Collection Hotel, New York City: a 54-floor, nearly all-suite hotel on West 54th Street in Midtown Manhattan, with suites laid out like a London flat
best_for: Travelers who want suite space with a separate living area in Midtown
Art and culture lovers who want MoMA, Carnegie Hall and Central Park close by

facts.text: The hotel is at 151 West 54th Street, between Sixth and Seventh Avenues, with MoMA a block south, Carnegie Hall three blocks north and Central Park just beyond.
The hotel spans 54 floors in Midtown Manhattan.
Nearly every accommodation at the hotel is a suite.
Every suite is laid out like a London flat, with living space apart from the bedroom and a dedicated workspace.
Rooms are designed with herringbone wood floors, hand-tufted rugs and Carrara marble bathrooms.
Bathrooms have a whirlpool tub and marble vanities.
In-room comforts include an espresso machine, bathrobes and slippers.
The signature accommodations include the light-filled Atrium Suite, the Sky Suites and the Penthouse.
The fitness center features Technogym equipment, including the Technogym Kinesis Personal Heritage.
Dabble, the hotel's restaurant near Carnegie Hall, suits pre-theatre dining or a nightcap.

highlights.text: Complimentary MoMA admission is available to hotel guests.
The Park View suites and the Premium Park View Apartment look out across Central Park.
A weekly Friday guided tour explores the hotel's art collection, with works by Matisse and Warhol alongside a Venice Biennale sculpture and a Turner Prize winner.
Each evening Dabble serves a complimentary Epicurean Moment of seasonal bites paired with wines and beers made in New York State.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes the Midtown setting brings bustling urban energy, street noise and foot traffic.
